Ξ ξ,ξεῖ (q.v.), τό, indecl., fifteenth (later fourteenth) letter of most of the Eastern Greek alphabets, including the Ionic (later general Gr.) alphabet ; not used in Western Greek alphabets or in the native Attic alphabet ; in form and serial position () it corresponds to the Semitic
samech (a form of s), but has acquired the new value ks ; as numeral ξ'= , but <νυμ τειφορμ͂"νυμ">ξ'<ν́υμ>= ,.
